module.title: Work: Meetings
module.description:
Meetings for users.
This module comes with:
- CRUD management - HTML editor - participants assignment - status process / work flow - mails on creation and reminder - jobs for mails - --dashboard panel--
module.author: Christian Würker
module.sql:
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>meetings`; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `<%?prefix%>meetings` ( `meetingId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `creatorId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `type` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `priority` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `status` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `dateStart` date DEFAULT NULL, `dateEnd` date DEFAULT NULL, `location` varchar(250) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `title` varchar(250) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `content` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci, `link` varchar(250) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL, `createdAt` decimal(12,0) unsigned NOT NULL, `modifiedAt` decimal(12,0) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`meetingId`), KEY `creatorId` (`creatorId`), KEY `type` (`type`), KEY `priority` (`priority`), KEY `status` (`status`), KEY `dateStart` (`dateStart`), KEY `dateEnd` (`dateEnd`), KEY `title` (`title`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>meeting_participants`; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `<%?prefix%>meeting_participants` ( `meetingParticipantId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `meetingId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `userId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `type` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `status` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `createdAt` decimal(12,0) unsigned NOT NULL, `modifiedAt` decimal(12,0) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`meetingParticipantId`), KEY `meetingId` (`meetingId`), KEY `userId` (`userId`), KEY `type` (`type`), KEY `status` (`status`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>meetings`; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>meeting_participants`;
